unit: one canonical manually adjudicated claim/evidence unit per document; segments may cross pages/blocks
tp: one prediction record matched to one in-scope canonical gold unit with all context checks preserved
fp: each unmatched independent prediction record, including extra duplicates and out-of-scope records
fn: each unmatched in-scope gold unit, including gold from failed/partial/interrupted/cancelled papers
gold_out_of_scope: excluded from FN; keep counts and rationale
duplicates: additional prediction records cannot increase TP and count FP; repeated blocks are segments of one unit, never additional gold units
real_gate: independent human full-text annotation with complete page checklist
all scope labels and matching edges adjudicated with actor/time/basis
overall_aggregation: micro TP/FP/FN across every listed document without dropping failures
preliminary_directions: 证据引用、否定、不确定、条件及数值单位可逐条核对
严格范围内漏抽和范围外独立误收分别报告；不限模式保留新特征
跨页及重复表述按预先裁定单元计数
论文族防泄漏、完整金标和失败输入均可追溯
质量保证下减少等待，S3/S4开发集实测后共同确定最终数值，S6前冻结
human_confirmation_items: 证据单元拆分和同篇重复表述归并规则
既定保留定义/本研究观察/转引范围内的标注拆分、类型判别及计分/分层细则
临床复合结论与其具体影像表现如何拆分
具体同义、上下位、序列/期相和癌种适用关系
来源许可和全文范围核对，最终开发/回归及另行收集封存资料划分
